title: Yellowed Flaky Thai Cobnuts Moo Ping
description: A traditional Thai dish featuring cobnuts, this recipe is an earthy and flaky hangover cure, made with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients and cooked to perfection on a robata grill in the form of moo ping.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat.
In a blender or food processor, combine coconut milk, fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, turmeric, ginger, garlic, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth.
Add the cobnuts to the blender and blend until well combined and the mixture forms a thick paste.
Using your hands, shape the paste into small cylindrical shapes, about 1 inch in length and 1/2 inch in diameter.
Thread the shaped paste onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the robata grill with oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the moo ping for 5-7 minutes on each side, or until they are lightly charred and cooked through.
Serve the yellowed flaky Thai cobnuts moo ping hot, garnished with fresh herbs and a side of spicy sauce if desired.
